headline: Claim Drew Lock (bid 3, no drop needed) before tonight's waiver run at 12:05 AM PT — Danny has an open bench spot and Lock is Seattle's active starter with Darnold hurt, fixing the week-6 QB bye hole.
summary: Danny is 1-0 at 168.42 points with A.J. Brown out on IR (high ankle sprain, out roughly through week 8) and no other injury issues on his active roster. The lineup is essentially right for week 2 except one FLEX swap: Khalil Shakir's Thursday-night matchup and team total are much stronger than Tre Tucker's Sunday spot. Two clean actions today: a cheap waiver claim to patch the week-6 QB bye hole, and a Thursday-deadline lineup swap.

lineup.why: Shakir projects for more targets (5.8 vs 5.3) on a Bills team favored by 4.5 with a 29.5 implied total, versus Tucker as a 6.5-point underdog with an 18.5 implied total.
lineup.evidence: Shakir is BUF's clear WR2 behind DJ Moore and played through his Week 1 role (4 of 6 targets) after an August ankle scare that did not carry into the season; no Sleeper injury flag on him now. Tucker is confirmed LV's WR1 by snaps and routes in Week 1 (48 snaps, 27 routes) but the Raiders' offense runs through Ashton Jeanty at RB and Tucker faces a tougher Chargers defense on the road.

adds.why: Bye-week insurance claim (tier per the season plan's bye rule, 1-3): Danny has an open bench spot (16 of 18 roster spots filled) so no drop is required, and Lock has a different bye (11) than Burrow and Willis, who both hit bye 6 in four weeks.
adds.evidence: Lock is confirmed Seattle's starter with Sam Darnold (hip, MRI Sept 9-10) out for Week 2 at Arizona; coach Macdonald called it a possible 1-2 week issue, so Lock's runway past week 3-4 is unresolved. Danny's bench (Willis, Gainwell, Lloyd, Shakir) has one open slot beyond those four, confirmed from the roster count (16 of 18 spots used, 1 of 2 IR used).

flags.what: High ankle sprain, MRI Sept 9-10, placed on IR Sept 11; reported to miss about 6 weeks (out through roughly week 8, no surgery).
Confirmed change-of-pace/passing-down role behind Bucky Irving per Bucs coaching comments (Todd Bowles: Irving starter, Gainwell the '1B') — bench-only volume, not a start.

watch.what: Hip injury timeline — if he returns before week 6, Drew Lock loses his starting job and the bye-week claim needs a rethink.
Expected back around week 8; watch practice reports as that window approaches before planning his return to the lineup.

alerts.title: ➕ Claim Drew Lock before tonight's run
alerts.body: Waiver run is 12:05 AM PT tonight (Wed Sep 16). Bid 3 for Drew Lock (SEA), no drop needed — you have an open bench spot. Fixes the week-6 bye hole (Burrow and Willis both off that week).

alerts.title: 🔁 Start Shakir over Tucker before Thursday
alerts.body: Set Khalil Shakir in FLEX for Tre Tucker before Thursday 5:15 PM PT kickoff. Bills' 29.5 implied total and favorite spot beat Tucker's 18.5 implied total as a big underdog.
